'''Kristy Grant''' is a [[human]] located in [[Feathermoon Stronghold]] in [[Feralas]]. She had previously been located in [[Thalanaar]] prior to the exile of [[Commander Anashya Starfall]] and her sentinels.

==Relatives==
She may be related to [[Kelly Grant]] and [[Kimberly Grant]].
